data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘Christos’, meaning ‘anointed one’. In Christianity, the name Christel symbolizes being anointed with the love, grace, and power of Christ. The name Christel carries the meaning “Anointed with Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Christel usually hope their child will grow to embody anointed with christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Christel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
